shared_qualifications: C19: Table 5 V vs SCE x1000 gives mV vs SCE, with no reference-electrode offset. Table 1 is explicitly EDX alloy composition in wt.%, so no atomic-to-mass conversion is applied.

The source explicitly labels these values pitting potentials. For Cu-containing alloys, however, the paper describes preferential attack of Cu-rich/Cr-depleted interdendrites and galvanic coupling with the dendrites. This physical qualification is retained without excluding the known identities.

The source specifies aerated 3.5% NaCl at25 C, while the CSV gives an additional chloride molarity0.6128 and pH7. The inspected source does not independently establish that molarity or pH, so neither is inferred from a generic percent solution or used as identity evidence.
